name: tb-fub-toolkit
description: Follow Up Boss reporting and outbound SMS skills for Texting Betty. AI-generated output can be wrong -- verify before acting on it. Configure one value: your Follow Up Boss API key.

risk_acknowledged.title: I understand the risks of using AI with my CRM
risk_acknowledged.description: This tool is driven by AI, and AI gets things wrong. It can misread your data, miscount, misclassify a reply, or state something confidently that is not true. It acts on your live Follow Up Boss account and can send real text messages to real people -- messages that cannot be unsent, and that carry TCPA and Do-Not-Call obligations that remain entirely yours. Treat everything it reports as a draft to verify, not as fact. Check any list before you act on it, and confirm every recipient before a send. You are responsible for what gets sent from your account. Tick this box only if you accept that.

fub_api_key.title: FUB API key
fub_api_key.description: Your Follow Up Boss API key. Find it in FUB under Admin > API. This is the only credential needed: the account, subdomain, and Texting Betty routing are all derived from it. Note: stored in this app's local settings in plain text, not masked, and visible in the model's context while a skill runs -- treat a session transcript the way you would treat the key itself.
